mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payroll employment over the past month indicates strengthening consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 9.0%, it signals persistent inflation triggering central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 9.0% YoY, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0 (index, 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing sector weakness reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals tightening monetary policy amid strong labor market, reducing liquidity and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates broad economic slowdown reducing corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), a rising unemployment rate signals policy effectiveness reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market overheating (UNRATE < 3.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals wage inflation risks triggering central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 3.0% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
